extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: school bus (conventional), approx. 11.3 x 2.5 x 3.2 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 1.0 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; the stop arm 'school-bus_stop_arm' is a separate object with its origin on its vertical hinge (rotate around local Z, approx. -90 degrees swings it out); 4 wheel objects (rear with dual tires) are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll), the front wheels also steer around local Z; opaque tinted windows, no interior; lettering 'SCHOOL BUS' and 'STOP' in grab3d's own stroke font; no brand

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
